v0.16.3.title_en: v0.16.3 — Reliability, privacy & notes-integrity hardening (Insights retired)
v0.16.3.body_en:
## Nexus v0.16.3

The second half of a multi-agent code review — v0.16.2 shipped the note-loss P1 fixes; this is the broad reliability, privacy, and integrity hardening that followed.

### Transcription reliability
- A **mid-session network reconnect** no longer scrambles transcript order or "Me" attribution — the stream clock now stays session-absolute across a dropped/re-opened socket.
- Recordings that end unexpectedly are handled cleanly: an **OS-ended screen-share**, a failed start, or a capture error now **finalize the meeting** instead of leaving it stuck "Recording".
- Rapid start/stop, concurrent recovery, and calendar auto-start are race-guarded; Gladia's `stop()` is re-entrancy-safe.

### Post-call Insights retired
- Gladia no longer produces post-call insights, and **Deepgram is now the recommended provider**. Gladia stays selectable for transcription; any existing insights remain viewable.

### Privacy & data
- **"Wipe all data" now securely erases** (secure_delete + VACUUM + WAL truncate) so meeting content isn't recoverable afterward, and it resets edited built-in templates.
- **Backup/restore round-trips every field** — paragraph breaks, filler-word styling, expected speakers, language, and folder/tag colors.

### Notes integrity
- Enhanced-notes edits are protected on re-enhance, Original↔Enhanced toggles, and pane switches; the serializer keeps blockquotes, code, nested lists, and spacer paragraphs.
- Enhanced notes stay in the **transcript's language** (no drift to English) on the degraded, summary, and no-detection paths.

### Under the hood
- Central IPC sender guard, process-level crash logging, migration-safety guards, quit-time usage-save fix, and OpenAI reasoning-model support (`max_completion_tokens`).

v0.16.0.title_en: v0.16.0 — European Portuguese support & Deepgram tuning
v0.16.0.body_en:
## Nexus v0.16.0 — European Portuguese support & Deepgram tuning

### What's new
- **European Portuguese now works properly.** Gladia can't transcribe European Portuguese (pt-PT), so the language picker hides that option when Gladia is selected and points you to Deepgram, whose model is tuned for European Portuguese.
- **Fixed a "401 / key rejected" error on Deepgram.** Pasted API keys are now cleaned up automatically — a stray "Token " prefix, quotes, or invisible characters no longer break the connection — and the error message tells you what to check.
- **Steadier Deepgram transcription.** A shorter keep-alive avoids idle disconnects on long meetings, the last words of a meeting are no longer cut off when you stop, numbers render as digits, and a new keyterm hint improves recognition of names and jargon.

v0.11.0.title_en: v0.11.0 — "ultra-moderno" UI overhaul + new brand mark
v0.11.0.body_en:
## Nexus v0.11.0

The big **"ultra-moderno" UI overhaul** — a dark-first, layered redesign of the whole app, plus a new brand mark. Auto-update will pick this up automatically.

### What's new
- **Dark-first, layered visual system.** New duotone **iris → cyan** accent, self-hosted **Geist Sans + Geist Mono**, and a depth/glass/glow token set. Glass is reserved for floating surfaces only; content stays opaque and crisp. AA-tuned contrast, full light/dark/system + reduced-motion support.
- **New app shell.** A left **rail** for the primary destinations (Home · Meetings · Templates · Chat · Settings), a contextual panel, and a focused content canvas. Settings is now a full page.
- **Home / Today hero** — your next meeting and one-tap **Start capture** front and center.
- **Signature Capture HUD** — a floating, glassy capture control with live VU meters and a recording timer, reachable from anywhere while you record.
- **Transcript & chat polish** — cyan/iris speaker rails (your own voice = cyan, others = iris), citation chips, and a cleaner peek/split layout.
- **New "orbit-node" brand mark** — the monogram is replaced by an orbiting-node symbol (a central node, a tilted orbit ring, and a satellite in motion). Icons, splash, and logo regenerated.

### Fixes
- Capture can no longer run with the mic hot but **no visible Stop** — the app pins you to the Meetings view while recording and disables off-destination navigation.
- Fixed new-note-from-Home not opening the editor, and Home "Recent notes" leaking the sidebar search filter.
- Fixed a window-overflow bug where the transcript panel, language selector, capture diagnostics, and the Peek/Enhance/Start header buttons could be clipped at the right edge.

### Notes
- The product name stays **Nexus**; your existing data, settings, and database are untouched.
- Privacy invariants are unchanged: no audio is ever written to disk, and your API keys never leave the main process.

v0.10.1.body_en:
## v0.10.1 — Local diarization accuracy overhaul

Rebuilds the on-device engine that separates **who said what** for remote speakers, targeting two reported problems on real meetings:

- **Two same-gender speakers no longer collapse into one.** Two women — or two men — on the same call are now told apart.
- **Fewer phantom speakers.** A speaker already on the call is no longer occasionally re-invented as a brand-new "Speaker".

### What changed
- **New voice model — 3D-Speaker ERes2NetV2.** Replaces the previous WavLM model; it roughly halves the error rate on exactly the cases that failed (same-gender voices and short clips). The new model (~71 MB) downloads once on first use — you can pre-fetch it in **Settings → Transcription**.
- **Threshold-free speaker grouping.** Instead of a single hand-tuned "how similar is close enough" cutoff (which could never separate every speaker), speakers are re-grouped at the end of the meeting using a method that figures out the number of speakers on its own.
- **Optional participant count.** Set the number of people on a call (next to the language selector) and the app will split exactly that many remote speakers — the single biggest accuracy lever when you know the count.

### Notes
- All speaker separation stays **on your device** — audio is never written to disk or uploaded. "Me" detection is unchanged.
- Works the same in Portuguese and English (the voice model is language-agnostic).
- Updates install automatically in the background.

v0.10.0.body_en:
# Nexus v0.10.0 — a top-to-bottom UI/UX overhaul

A big polish release built around one principle: **every action gives you feedback.**

## ✨ Highlights
- **Feedback everywhere.** Actions now confirm themselves right where they happen, with toasts reserved for background events. The headline fix: *About → Check for updates* finally tells you what's happening instead of doing nothing.
- **A calmer, more consistent look.** Smoother, purposeful motion (and full **reduce-motion** support), plus a refreshed colour system that clearly separates the sidebar, your notes, and side panels — with proper contrast in both light and dark.

## 🎙 Recording
- Live elapsed timer, mic/system level meters, and a clear "Recording" indicator.
- A "Listening…" state before the first words arrive, clearer reconnection, a "Recording saved" confirmation on stop, and friendlier audio diagnostics with a mic-silence hint.

## 📝 Notes
- A shared autosave indicator and a calm "Generating…" state while AI notes are written.
- A clearer line between *your* notes and *AI* notes, a skimmable key-points list, and a retryable banner if enhancement degrades. **Your notes are never overwritten.**

## 🗂 Folders, tags & sidebar
- Note counts, an active-filter bar with one-click clear, and **per-folder / per-tag accent colours** so you can organise things your way.
- Drag a note onto a folder to move it, friendlier delete confirmations, and full keyboard support.

## 💬 Transcript & chat
- Jump-to-latest, find-in-transcript, cleaner speaker grouping, and a copy menu (plain or timestamped).
- Click a citation in chat to jump to the exact spot in the transcript.

## ♿ Accessibility
- Keyboard operability and visible focus across new surfaces, screen-reader labels, reduced-motion support, and status that never relies on colour alone.

---
This release is purely about how the app looks and feels — nothing changed in how audio is captured or transcribed. As always: **no audio is ever written to disk, and your API keys never leave your machine.**

Updates install automatically; you can also check from **Settings → Updates**.

v0.9.2.body_en:
## Nexus 0.9.2 — stability & correctness

A maintenance release from a full‑codebase review. No new features — 12 fixes, including two data‑integrity/privacy invariants. Auto‑update installs it automatically.

**Fixes**
- Transcription no longer defaults to English on a fresh install — it auto‑detects (or uses your chosen language).
- "Wipe all data" now also removes your custom templates.
- More resilient Deepgram reconnect — no runaway reconnect loops on a flaky network.
- A trailing line of transcript is no longer dropped when you stop a recording.
- Microsoft Calendar stays connected more reliably (no spurious "please reconnect").
- Offline Whisper can no longer hang the app on quit.
- Search works correctly after restoring from a backup.
- More accurate cost estimates for meetings recorded across multiple sessions.
- Sturdier error handling for the Insights panel and calendar disconnect.
- The update screen no longer says "Downloading…" before a download actually starts.

Under the hood: one additive database migration (channel‑accurate cost), 359 tests green, no new dependencies.
